title: Your App Needs an AI Chatbot

beats: It's two in the morning. Your team is asleep.
But your app is still answering customers.
That's an AI chatbot. And in this era, every app and website needs one. Here's why.
For customers, it means instant answers, twenty-four seven.
Order tracking, product picks, and stock checks, in any language.
And when it gets complex, it hands the chat to a human, with the full context.
For owners, it's a control panel you can talk to.
Upload products just by describing them.
Calculate invoices and reports in seconds.
And get low stock alerts and security warnings automatically.
You set the rules once. It runs them every day.
Is it real? Klarna reported its AI assistant handled two thirds of its customer chats in the first month. That's the work of about seven hundred agents.
A Stanford and M.I.T. study found AI assistance helped support agents resolve fourteen percent more issues per hour.
And Gartner predicts AI will resolve eighty percent of common service issues by twenty twenty-nine.
Air Canada was held responsible when its chatbot gave a customer the wrong refund policy.
Ground it in your own data, confirm important actions, and keep a human one tap away.
So, is your app ready for AI?
